entries.failure: Active-word highlighting changed font weight and caused horizontal jitter.
entries.prevention: Zero-Jitter CSS invariant forbids layout-changing highlight properties.

entries.failure: Empty translations or malformed vocabulary reached release validation.
entries.prevention: Release validation rejects empty translations and every malformed vocabulary entry.

entries.failure: HTML could be compiled without an independent verified release authorization.
entries.prevention: The builder requires a validator-issued ReleaseToken bound to the report hash.

entries.failure: Global alignment accepted weak or ambiguous matches as if they were validated.
entries.prevention: Weak matches require review; a manual exception ledger cannot waive algorithmic alignment failures.

entries.failure: Local source filenames, reader URLs, and cloud object names diverged during publication.
entries.prevention: AudioManifest records one explicit chapter-to-source-to-object mapping and publication uses browser-compatible range verification.

entries.failure: A resumable run could lose its identity when the manifest was updated between stages.
entries.prevention: Run manifests preserve run_id and created_at across stage updates.

entries.failure: Cloud credentials were embedded in a temporary uploader script and upload scope was inferred from hardcoded tasks.
entries.prevention: R2 uploads require environment-only credentials and an explicit manifest; dry-run validates the complete scope before transfer.
